authority.description: authority is the address that controls the module (defaults to x/gov unless overwritten).

params.description: params defines the x/bank parameters to update. NOTE: All parameters must be supplied.

cosmos.bank.v1beta1.MsgUpdateParams.title: Msg Update Params
cosmos.bank.v1beta1.MsgUpdateParams.description: MsgUpdateParams is the Msg/UpdateParams request type.

send_enabled.description: Deprecated: Use of SendEnabled in params is deprecated. For genesis, use the newly added send_enabled field in the genesis object. Storage, lookup, and manipulation of this information is now in the keeper. As of cosmos-sdk 0.47, this only exists for backwards compatibility of genesis files.

cosmos.bank.v1beta1.Params.title: Params
cosmos.bank.v1beta1.Params.description: Params defines the parameters for the bank module.

cosmos.bank.v1beta1.SendEnabled.title: Send Enabled
cosmos.bank.v1beta1.SendEnabled.description: SendEnabled maps coin denom to a send_enabled status (whether a denom is sendable).

cosmos.bank.v1beta1.MsgUpdateParamsRespo.title: Msg Update Params Response
cosmos.bank.v1beta1.MsgUpdateParamsRespo.description: MsgUpdateParamsResponse defines the response structure for executing a MsgUpdateParams message.
